newsitem.title: USA: Concorde Gaming to acquire Colorado casino.
newsitem.headline: Concorde Gaming to acquire Colorado casino.

text.p: Concorde Gaming Corp said Tuesday it has entered an agreement to acquire the assets and operations of Golden Gates Casino in Black Hawk, Colorado, in exchange for its South Dakota video lottery routes, cash and stock.
Concorde plans to acquire the casino from North Star Casino Llc for the video lottery routes, $870,000 in cash, assumption of about $380,000 in liabilities and 1.7 million shares of common stock.

If Concorde does not receive a license to operate the casino from the Colorado Gaming Commission, then North Star will pay Concorde $1.6 million for the South Dakota video lottery assets, Concorde said.

"This is the first step in the company's plan to divest its video lottery operations and to focus its efforts and resources on the ownership and operation of gaming establishments, an area the company has an established expertise," Jerry Baum, president and chief executive officer of Concorde said.

"In addition, the economics of owning and operating gaming establishments are substantially better than the South Dakota video lottery operation where South Dakota's share was 50 percent and the better locations were harder to retain."
